attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moving sanitize_html and supported_cultures filter registration into core (unconditional) removes the RequireFeatures gating on OrchardCore.Html/Localization, so tenants without those features enabled will still get the filters registered and could hit DI resolution failures for SanitizeHtmlFilter's dependencies at runtime."}

reason: Moving sanitize_html and supported_cultures filter registration into core (unconditional) removes the RequireFeatures gating on OrchardCore.Html/Localization, so tenants without those features enabled will still get the filters registered and could hit DI resolution failures for SanitizeHtmlFilter's dependencies at runtime.
